mechanism: Perphenazine may impair glucose metabolism and antagonize the hypoglycemic effects of glyburide through dopamine antagonism and alpha-adrenergic effects, while glyburide metabolism may be affected by perphenazine's CYP450 inhibition.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; perphenazine may reduce glyburide efficacy and increase hyperglycemia risk; dose adjustment of glyburide may be necessary.
